company.name: Kodiak Cakes
company.one_liner: Whole-grain, high-protein pancake and waffle mix from a Utah family business.

facts.summary: A pancake and waffle mix made with whole grains. Joel Clark started selling it door-to-door as a teenager in the 1980s, and the brand has grown slowly in grocery stores since.
highlights: The recipe is a family recipe based on whole wheat and oat flour.
The business has been around for decades and is already in grocery stores.
Growth has been slow and steady; the founders want capital to expand distribution.
Pancake mix is a crowded, low-margin grocery category with big incumbents.

real_deal.summary: No deal. The Sharks didn't come to terms with the founders.

outcome.headline: Became a protein-pancake powerhouse; private-equity firm L Catterton bought a majority stake in 2021.
outcome.story: Kodiak rode the protein trend into nearly every US grocery store and reportedly reached about $200M in annual sales. L Catterton acquired a majority stake in 2021 (terms undisclosed). The value here (~$500M) is an estimate, and earlier investors would have been diluted.
